title: PixSystem
description:
PixSystem
It is an add-on that manages the server from deleting abandoned stuff and protecting the server from spawn and other additional things
body: PixSystem Essential Server Management & Player Experience PluginPixSystem is a comprehensive and free Minecraft server plugin designed to provide essential management tools and enhance the player experience seamlessly. It offers a suite of features to optimize server performance, streamline communication, and ensure a smooth gameplay environment.Key Features & BenefitsPerformance Enhancement (ClearLag): The system automatically clears unnecessary items from the ground, significantly reducing server lag and maintaining optimal speed for all players.•Communication System (Auto Broadcast): Utilize the auto-broadcast feature to regularly send important alerts, server rules, and announcements to your players.•Chat Protection (Anti-Spam): Prevent repetitive and annoying messages in chat, fostering a clean and organized communication environment.•Professional Welcome System: Greet new players with attractive and engaging titles upon joining your server.•Full Customization: Easily modify all messages, sounds, and plugin settings through intuitive configuration files.•Commands & Permissions
